hook.text: Harvard's Getting to Yes has sold over 15 million copies by teaching one idea: both sides can gain.

buildup.text: Most people approach negotiation as a fixed pie. If you get more, I must get less. That's often wrong.

discovery.text: Expanding the pie means finding value neither side initially considered. Creative options multiply options.

twist.text: Win-win doesn't mean splitting 50/50. It means both sides walk away better off than their best alternative.

climax.text: Before negotiating, identify your BATNA: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement. It sets your floor.

punchline.text: Know your walk-away point. Then find shared gain.

quiz.question: What is a BATNA in negotiation?
options: The maximum amount you are willing to pay
Your best alternative if negotiation fails
